sources.title: Nebraska RB Emmett Johnson would be an exciting option for the Broncos on day 3 of the draft
sources.description: One prospect who may interest the Denver Broncos in the middle rounds of the 2026 NFL Draft is Nebraska running back Emmett Johnson. He is a 5-10, 202-pound running back who is one of the better overall backs in the entire draft. Johnson is an explosive downhill running back who gives it his all each […]
